### New file: `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/eplb_utils.py`

Following the package's coding-style mandate to keep feature-specific complexity out of the shared model runner, this module provides guarded facades:

- **`EplbState`** — Wraps the real `vllm.distributed.eplb.eplb_state.EplbState`. Constructor takes `(parallel_config, device)`. Its `add_model`, `step`, `start_async_loop` methods and the `from_mapping` classmethod are all **inert no-ops** when EPLB is disabled or the model isn't a mixture-of-experts. - **`EPLBController`** — Constructor `(parallel_config, device)` plus a `step(eplb_state, ...)` method that applies the `enable_eplb` guard and delegates to the state (passing `log_balancedness` for stats).
